_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v543_dual_decoder_50k/audits/parity_certificate.json (plan §5.8 + §7.1 S0-A / ADR-0034 §3). This is the S0-A ZERO-RESIDUAL parity certificate for the three same-seed V542 A0 checkpoints — it proves that the V543 frozen CoarseEncoder (A0 strict load + message_mlp[-1]/norm_h[-1]/fc2 hooks + shared w_v) plus the parameter-free Bridge reproduce the V542 A0 forward pass EXACTLY, with zero decoder residual. It is NOT evidence for training comparability, H2/H3 baseline substitution, or any candidate gain: those require the matched V543 M0/P0 recomputed baseline and the formal runs. PASS is decided by CPU bitwise equality; GPU tolerances are hard caps (atol 1e-6 / rtol 1e-5) and a run-to-run floor above the cap makes GPU parity inconclusive, never relaxed. State-dict counting is recorded under TWO explicit 口径 that must never be mixed: `payload_key_count` = the checkpoint payload key count with the w_v dual-write counted ONCE (43 = 37 backbone + 6 process_head; ADR-0033 identity 口径), and `expanded_target_key_count` = the strict-load expanded target key count with w_v counted TWICE (45 = 37 backbone + 2 move_decoder.w_v + 6 process_head; plan §1.2 口径); the only legal expansion is the declared w_v alias, so the two differ by exactly 2 (the alias expands into backbone.w_v + move_decoder.w_v). Every single-checkpoint row carries `state_dict_counts` with the two MEASURED values plus `count_scope_of_this_audit`, which must name the 口径 its per-key assertions use.

zero_residual_equations.note: plan §5.8 / §7.1 S0-A: 七等式逐元素验证 (CPU bitwise); tanh(q0_raw)==q 必须在同一 dtype/device 下比较; order_score 必须是 q 本身 (同一张量语义), 不是并列头

asset_policy.source_tier_note: 三个资产 = outputs/pesn/v542_backbone_50k/runs/V542_A0_S{17,29,43}/checkpoint_best.pt (V542 A0 matched 重训基线的最佳 inner-val checkpoint); path + SHA 已在 config source.checkpoints 钉死; smoke 路径与非钉死 checkpoint 一律禁止 (parity 资产必须可追溯到冻结 run)

load_audit.rule: strict-audit mapping: read file SHA-256 + payload['model']; load through the V542 A0 adapter/loader (A0LegacyBackbone subclass, shared w_v); missing/unexpected/shape_mismatch/dtype_mismatch ALL empty; load_state_dict(strict=True); per-key torch.equal(source, target) after load

hooks.message_mlp[-1]: edge_msg capture, fires exactly once, removed in finally, never detached
hooks.norm_h[-1]: last-layer h capture, fires exactly once, removed in finally, never detached
hooks.progress_head.fc2: q0_raw capture, fires exactly once, removed in finally, never detached

state_dict_count_semantics._note: 两个 state-dict 计数口径必须分别记录、分别断言, 禁止混用 (mapping 审计断言必须写明用的是哪一个口径)。WP0 只冻结口径与字段; 证书实例填实测值。

payload_key_count.definition: checkpoint payload 的键数 (payload['model'] 的原始键集大小), w_v 双写只计一次
payload_key_count.authority: ADR-0033 identity 口径 (run identity / 资产身份按该口径记账)
payload_key_count.derivation: 37 backbone 键 (backbone.w_v 只计一次) + 6 process_head 键 = 43

expanded_target_key_count.definition: strict 加载展开后的目标键数 (别名键按 tensor 别名展开), w_v 双写计两次 (backbone.w_v + move_decoder.w_v)
expanded_target_key_count.authority: 主方案 §1.2 口径 (strict-load / mapping 目标键集)
expanded_target_key_count.derivation: 37 backbone + 2 move_decoder.w_v (backbone.w_v <-> move_decoder.w_v 同一 tensor, 展开成两个目标键) + 6 process_head = 45

state_dict_count_semantics.consistency_rule: expanded_target_key_count = payload_key_count + 2 (唯一合法展开 = 声明的 w_v 双写别名展开为 backbone.w_v + move_decoder.w_v 两个目标键); 差值 != 2 说明存在未声明别名或静默键过滤 => 审计失败

real_batch_parity.rule: same CPU bitwise on real inner-val batches; fixture pass + real-batch fail => data-dependent boundary bug (empty edges, degK=0, key without in-edges) must be diagnosed, never waived

gpu_tolerance.hard_caps_note: GPU <=1e-6 (atol) / 1e-5 (rtol) 是硬上限; 任何 run-to-run 地板规则都不得放宽该容差 (no tolerance relaxation)
gpu_tolerance.legacy_floor_rule: run the parity twice first to measure the run-to-run floor; the floor is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — GPU pass/fail is decided solely by the hard caps; if the measured floor exceeds the cap => GPU parity INCONCLUSIVE; CPU bitwise remains decisive

bridge_parity.note: Bridge 不引入可训练参数; 固定投影矩阵以 persistent=False buffer 存放, 不进入 optimizer; bridge_spec_sha256 覆盖全部固定构造 (8 通道 key_v / 48 维 pair_s / key 邻接 / token 布局)

failure_procedure: 3_fix_then_bump_matching_identity_layer (code => code_sha256; data => source_manifest_sha256; init => checkpoint/init mapping; hook => capture spec)
